title: Per-tenant quota refresh bug causing cascading 429s across Dedicated and Private nodes
creator: Aisha Kwon
description: Summary: Several enterprise customers on Dedicated and Private deployments reported wide-spread 429s during high-load window on 2026-03-01. Investigation shows the quota refresh job sometimes applied quota deltas at the host level instead of tenant-level, leading to incorrect token counts after failover and a cascade of throttling across nodes. Impact: customer-facing production outages for affected tenants (low- to high-volume), increased latency and transparent 429s for in-flight requests, multiple escalations to Customer Success and Sales. Scope: Hosted API calls were mostly unaffected; Dedicated and Private clusters that use our legacy quota-refresh path and the regional proxy path were impacted. This ticket tracks the production bugfix, validation, and follow-up hardening.
steps_to_reproduce: Start a Dedicated cluster with at least 3 nodes and tenant-level quotas configured (burst + steady windows)
Simulate sustained client ramp to exceed steady quota for a tenant while concurrently shutting down one node (simulate failover)
Observe quota refresh job logs and Redis entries: when failover occurs some refresh tasks write the refreshed token value using host-scoped key instead of tenant-scoped key
Result: other nodes load the wrong token counts, apply immediate throttling and emit 429s for the tenant across the cluster
root_cause: Two contributing issues: 1) legacy quota refresh path (legacy_quota_refresher) used instance-scoped cache keys under heavy concurrency; 2) proxy-level burst-window normalization logic assumed refresh timestamps were region-aligned and applied corrective truncation which, combined with stale Redis TTLs, caused token counts to be decremented incorrectly after failover.
work_items: Hotfix: deploy patch to legacy_quota_refresher to compute and write tenant-scoped keys atomically (PR #1289)
Hotfix: add fast rollback guard that forces local in-memory quota state to rehydrate from authoritative store on leader-change
Tests: unit tests for key composition, integration test simulating node failover and refresh reconciliation
Observability: add metric quota.refresh.key_type and increase sampling on quota-refresh traces
Postmortem: schedule and publish incident postmortem; update runbooks and add chaos test to CI
comments: 2026-03-01 09:12 - Aisha Kwon: Triage call with CS and Eng on incoming customer escalations. Initial mitigation: increased quota smoothing window for impacted tenants and temporarily disabled legacy refresher for Dedicated clusters. Asked Eng to open P0.

2026-03-01 11:45 - Diego Morales: Reproduced locally with a 3-node Dedicated cluster. Confirmed host-scoped key writes in legacy_quota_refresher under concurrent refresh path. Preparing a targeted fix that switches key to tenant:{tenant_id}:{region}:{window} and uses SETNX+expire to avoid races.
2026-03-02 02:03 - Priya Shah (SRE): Deployed hotfix to staging and ran chaos scenario (node restart) — rehydration looks stable, no cross-node 429s introduced. Collecting perf/latency baseline.
2026-03-03 07:30 - Diego Morales: Hotfix PR #1289 created and CI green. Requesting urgent review from runtime leads. Annotated PR with benchmark results showing <1% tail-latency increase under load.

2026-03-04 15:20 - Marcus Li (Runtime Lead): Reviewed and approved PR. Noted trade-off: the atomic SETNX approach adds 1 Redis round-trip on refresh path; acceptable given P0 severity. Approve for canary rollout.
2026-03-05 02:00 - SRE Oncall: Canary rollout to Dedicated in us-west-2 completed. No repeat 429s observed during high-load window. Rolling to other regions on 2026-03-05 UTC.
2026-03-06 18:00 - Customer Success: Notified affected customers of fix and asked for validation. Two customers confirmed service restored; one requested deeper postmortem.

2026-03-08 10:45 - Diego Morales: Added metrics and traces to identify future mis-writes. Created an alert quota.refresh.mismatch.rate > 0.1% for 5m. Also submitted a follow-up ticket to rework legacy_quota_refresher into new canonical refresher in runtime-1.22.

2026-03-10 09:00 - Aisha Kwon: Drafted incident summary for leadership and scheduled postmortem presentation on 2026-03-15. Action items added to backlog. Marking ticket In Progress until follow-ups complete.
